item: An impossible date in a law catalogue ends in LawCatalogUnreadable naming the file and the class, under either YAML loader
summary: PyYAML's constructor rejects an impossible date such as 2026-13-45 with a ValueError, which is not a YAMLError, so _read_catalog_yaml let a bare ValueError out under both loaders and the contract that every unreadable catalogue ends in LawCatalogUnreadable (file name and error class only, never a path or the file's text) did not hold. It now catches ValueError beside YAMLError. Found by the independent read of the J3 head as older than its delta. Test over both the shared and the pure loader, red without.
